_note: TF-541 — what counts as a placeholder per Requirements 8.2, written down once and answered by both sides. The server substitutes when it renders and when it derives the variable set of a prompt; the browser does the same for the live preview and for the fields that appear while somebody types. Two notions of 'what is a variable' would let a prompt carry metadata for something that never renders, or render something that has no metadata — and neither would raise anything. Read by tests/backend/unit/placeholder_rule_test.rb and tests/frontend/placeholder_rule.test.js.

cases.why: digits and underscores after the first letter
40 characters is the limit and still a key
a digit may not start a key
a space inside is not a key
41 characters is not a variable at all (14.3)
